description: Get the current text of a specific Code of Federal Regulations section. Provide the title number, part, and section (e.g. title 40, part '98', section '98.411'). Returns the section's plain text, the date it is current as of, and the official eCFR URL.

date.description: Optional point-in-time ISO date yyyy-mm-dd; defaults to current.

name: reg_cfr_section
